batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c MS Wade b UT Yadav

batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: c R Tewatia b Rashid Khan

batting.name: R Parag
batting.dismissal: c V Shankar b MM Sharma

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: st SV Samson b YS Chahal

balls.text: nails the wide yorker on the last ball. Hetmyer can only squeeze it out towards extra cover for a single
off-pace and into the track on off stump. Samson is a little early into the stroke and drags it towards deep mid wicket
Umesh bowls it a mile outside off this time. In fact, it is even beyond the second tramline. More exercise for the umpire

another slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Samson jumps up and slashes at it. Misses this time but this has been called a wide. And GT go upstairs. Well above the head, and the original decision, which was of a wide, stays!

slow, short and wide outside off. No pace to work with for Samson but he still manages to lift it over backward point for a couple of runs. Samson did well to reach it, he had to jump onto his toes and stretch out considerably
watch that white ball fly! Juicy full toss on off stump and that deserved to go the distance. Samson sat back deep in his crease and walloped it over long on!
full and wide outside off. Hetmyer steps way across his stumps and squeezes it out towards deep cover
wow, just wow! Right in the slot outside off and guess what happens to those - they go miles! Hetmyer bends his back knee to generate elevation and carves it over wide long off!
dug in shorter outside off. Does not get up very much and Hetmyer drags it towards deep mid wicket. Might have been a slower one again
four first ball! Another change-up but this is also in the slot outside off. Hetmyer reads the variation, plants his front foot and bashes it over the bowler's head!

Parag perishes! Slower ball that lands right in the slot outside off. Parag lines it up and belts it flat. It is straight to Shankar at long off, though. he takes the catch initially but then loses his balance a little. Keeps his nerve, does his juggling act, steps outside, comes back in and completes the catch!
very full and very wide outside off. Parag throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep point for a brace
what a shot this is! Bangs it in way outside off. This is a slower bumper too, meaning that Parag has to generate all the pace. He leaps up into the air to do so and smears it over deep square leg!
slow, short and too wide outside off. Parag leaves it alone and the umpire calls it a wide
back of a length outside off. Samson sits back in his crease and tugs it towards long on
Johnson gets the wide yorker right again. Parag swishes at it but cannot lay any bat. With all that is happening, an eight-run over at this stage is worth its weight in gold

just short! Another wide yorker outside off. Samson looks for the reverse ramp this time but does not get all of it. Just clears the wicket-keeper and then it somehow lands in front of short third man
perfectly executed! Very full outside off. Samson shuffles across his stumps, gets into position for the lap and nails it over short fine leg!
shortish outside off. Parag stands tall and hacks it towards long on
another top yorker outside off. Samson digs it out into the off side
into the blockhole outside off. Parag walks across and chalks his attempted scoop towards short fine leg

oh dear, what has happened here?! Low full toss on off stump. Samson gets under it but does not get the power he is after. Chips it towards Tewatia at long on, who seems to lose it in the lights completely. He is already on the way down before the ball arrives, and it ends up going to his right. Looks like Tewatia tripped over his own feet while moving into position and that caused the stumble!

slower ball on a length way outside off. Samson swings himself off his feet but the ball just does not arrive. Almost rolled along the turf too. Called a wide and now, the Titans review. Samson was standing just a little outside off, which means the tramlines also move. The third umpire Ananthapadmanabhan reckons the ball is not wider than Samson's initial movement, and he asks the umpire to stay with his non-wide call. But the umpire signalled wide initially. Then, he asks for another replay and then says the original call stands, which was a wide. Not sure what has happened there, but it is not a good look. A bit comical for those not having a direct stake in it!
excellent wide yorker, sneaking just inside the tramlines. Samson wafts at it but cannot make contact
off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Samson hoicks it away towards deep backward square leg and scrambles back for two

slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Samson jumps up into the air to slash it away but only connects with fresh air. Not called a wide. Samson has a chat with his partner and then reviews it. Looks touch-and-go. The umpire reckons the ball is passing above the head, and the decision has been overturned. The right call too!
safe again! Off-pace and hung up well outside off. Parag has an ugly hack across the line and slices it terribly. Luckily for him, it evades backward point running to his right

the helicopter is out! Full on middle and off. Parag channels his inner MS Dhoni and snaps through the stroke. Whips it away towards deep mid wicket, where Umesh produces an inexplicable misfield and lets in four!
slower bumper on off. Gets a little big on Parag but he goes through with the pull anyway. Splices it towards deep mid wicket for a brace
another wrong'un, on a length on middle and leg. Spins back into Samson and traps him on the crease. Hits the pads but that was going well down leg
googly on a back of a length outside off. Parag picks it off the surface and turns it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on off. Samson uses the depth of the crease and eases it to long off
back of a length on off. Parag drops it into the on side and canters across to the other end
shortish on middle and off. Grips in the surface and spins slowly. Samson waits back and punches it to long on
angled into the pads. Parag uses the angle and works it calmly towards deep square leg
ends the over with a six! Johnson goes short but Samson is ready for this too. Picks up the length swiftly, gets into position and swats it over mid on!
stop what you are doing, and just watch Samson bat! This is on a back of a length outside off. Samson stands up tall, gets his hands through the ball and crrruuunnnchheesss it to extra cover's right!
fullish just outside off. Samson clears his front leg and drills it down the ground to mid on. That was in the slot, and Samson will feel he missed out, with mid on in the circle too
four more! Shortish outside off and the width is the problem again. Samson flashes hard at it and slashes it fine past third man!
length on middle and leg. Rushes onto Parag quicker than he expects and he cloths it towards deep mid wicket
dug in short on middle and off. Samson stays back and hacks it behind square on the leg side
hard length on middle and leg. Parag opens up his stance and pulls it towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
gets to fifty in some style! Half-tracker outside off that is begging to be hit. Parag obliges and dumps it over the wide long on fence. Third fifty this season for Parag!
hard length on off. Samson backs away again before chopping it into the off side for a single
gorgeous! Mohit goes for the off-stump yorker but errs on the shorter side. Ends up in the slot, and Samson gives himself room to cream it over extra cover!

slower ball on a back of a length outside off, perhaps as a response to Samson shaping for the scoop. The RR captain has no pace to work with and does not lay bat on ball. Samson sports a sheepish grin soon after
back of a length on off. Parag gets up on his toes and works it towards deep mid wicket
wrong'un on a length on leg stump. Samson comes forward and blocks
short outside off. Parag hops back and flat-bats it towards long off
six more! Parag is on a roll now! Another slot ball on the pads, and Noor gets met. Parag bends his back knee again, gets into position for the sweep and hoists it over deep square leg!
back of a length delivery hung up outside off. Samson tries to fetch it but can only chalk it off the toe-end towards long off
googly on a length on the stumps. Parag comes forward and nudges it into the off side for a sharpish single
right out of the screws! Floated up into the slot on leg stump. Parag gets down on one knee and mauls it high and long over deep mid wicket!
back-of-the-hand slower ball on a length outside off. Parag jabs it towards deep cover point
length just outside off. Another beautiful drive on the up by Samson but it fetches him just a single to long on
full on middle and off. Parag gets forward and flicks it down the ground to long on
shortish outside off. Samson stands tall and times it sweetly off the back foot towards deep cover point
slower bumper that goes awry and seems to balloon over the batter's head. It is quite wide, in terms of direction too, and the umpire indulges in some exercise
length on middle and off. Parag tips it to mid off and dashes across to the other end
back of a length on middle and leg. Samson punches it towards deep mid wicket
full on the pads. Parag lunges forward and nurdles it into the mid wicket region. Calls for the second and both batters make it comfortably enough
dropped shorter outside off. Parag loses his shape while trying to swing to leg and shanks it back to the bowler
finds the fence again! Full on leg stump, and Parag seems to have had enough of the pushing and prodding. Clears his front leg and mows it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!
very full on off stump. Samson nudges it towards point for another single
shortish on off. Parag goes back and knocks it to long off
googly on a length outside off. Samson gets forward and pushes it towards long off
back of a length on middle and off. Parag reads it off the pitch and defends
cleverly done! 94ks length ball outside off. Parag picks the line early and just cushions the impact. The open bat face takes it past backward point, and Parag collects four!
into the blockhole well outside off. Samson digs it out into the backward point region
very full outside off. Parag waits for it and slices it towards deep cover point
fired in full on middle and off. Parag comes forward and defends
googly on a length on middle and leg. Parag places it into the vast real estate in the wide long on region and picks up two
back of a length on middle and leg. Parag presses half forward and eases it down to long off

oh dear! Googly on a length on leg stump. Samson defends it towards backward point. The fielder fires in a throw at the bowler's end. Mohit should be backing it up at long on, but he misfields and lets in four!
another beautifully tossed up googly just outside off. It is on a full length and that draws Samson into the drive, only to then breeze past the outside edge
googly on a length on leg stump. Not sure Parag picks this and he plonks it off the outside half of the bat towards backward point
Parag breaks free! Just! Fuller and this is on leg stump. Parag gets his front foot out of the way, bends his back knee and just clears deep mid wicket!
googly on a length outside off. Parag goes feeling for it again and gets beaten on the outside
back of a length on off. Not a lot of bounce again as Parag pushes it down the ground
Wade puts down another chance! Length in the fifth stump channel just outside off. Grips in the surface and spins away. Parag nibbles at it and gets a nick that is grassed by Wade
lots of revs on this one. Drifts in on a length on off before straightening. Samson plays with an open bat face towards backward point
floated up full outside off. Parag gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off
shorter outside off. Parag stays back and stabs it towards short extra cover
full on middle and off. Parag lunges forward and pokes it towards short extra cover
fuller and flatter on the pads. Parag tucks it away towards deep mid wicket
lovely bowling! Googly tossed up on a length on off. Drops on the batter late and Parag cannot get to the pitch of the ball. Rips past the outside edge as he fishes at it
shortish outside off. Parag hangs back and jabs it past extra cover. The fielder did get a hand to it, though, and that means deep cover point can cut it off
back of a length outside off. Samson waits in his crease and punches it to long off
length just outside off. Parag presses forward and flicks it towards long on
short and wide outside off. Goes on with the angle and keeps low too. Goes under Parag's attempted cut
full just outside off. Parag gets onto the front foot and pats it gently towards short extra cover

was there a nick?! Floated up a little on a length outside off. Parag goes feeling for it and feathers it through to Wade, who cannot quite hold on. No confirmation on the edge yet, but the reaction from the GT fielders suggests there was bat involved. UltraEdge confirms the nick, and that will go down as a dropped chance. How costly will that prove to be?
googly on a length just outside off. Parag comes forward and pushes it into the off side

straight to slip! Fizzed through on a full length on off. Buttler looks at the length, and his eyes light up. He tries to go downtown but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. It straightens just enough, and takes the outside edge. Tewatia snaffles up a sharp chance at slip in front of his face, and the Royals are two down now!
googly on a back of a length on middle and leg. Buttler goes back and turns it towards mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off. Keeps low and squirms under Buttler's waft
fired in full on leg stump. Samson comes forward and knocks it down to long on
back of a length just outside off. Samson drops it behind point and saunters across to the other end
beautiful! Back of a length on middle and off. Samson lets the ball come to him before timing it exquisitely through mid wicket. Speeds away to the fence!
short, wide and punished! Lots of width, and that allows Samson to just throw his hands at it without any inhibition. Carves it past backward point for four!
length on middle and off. Sticks a little in the surface and Samson clinks it off the toe-end towards mid on

Umesh has the last laugh! Goes back to the back of a length ball, on middle and off. Jaiswal moves across his stumps, looking for the scoop. Gets cramped for room, though, and he gloves it through. Wade times his leap to absolute perfection and gobbles it up with both hands!
four more! Dug in short on middle and off. Jaiswal picks it up early, opens up his stance and heaves it over mid on. One bounce and into the fence!
shortish on leg stump. Buttler gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips past mid wicket for a brace
fullish just outside off. No shape on the attempted lofted off-drive again and Jaiswal miscues it towards mid off
well well! Back of a length outside off. Buttler shapes up for the scoop early but does not get the contact he desires. Pings off the thigh pad into the on side
hard length just outside off. Jaiswal tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it into the off side
length on middle and off. Buttler hangs back before bunting it towards mid off. Hares across to complete the single
full just outside off. Buttler comes forward and pushes it towards extra cover
back to back boundaries! Jaiswal is up and running! Back of a length delivery angled across the batter outside off. Jaiswal gets a decent stride in and thrashes it on the up to extra cover's left!
gets this through! A bit of width outside off and Jaiswal cashes in. Stands tall on this short of length ball and crashes it past cover point!
short on leg stump, and Jaiswal misses out. Gets decent enough contact on the pull but cannot help it past Shankar at short fine leg
shortish on middle and leg. Jaiswal goes back and taps it towards mid on
back of a length on off. Jaiswal gets behind it and meets the ball right under his eyes
hard length, angling into off stump. Buttler presses half forward and stabs it to mid on's right for a single
what timing! A tad short just outside off. Jaiswal stays leg side and that creates room. Gets on top of the bounce and scythes it past backward point!
back of a length, but again denying Jaiswal the room he wants. He slashes at it anyway and is beaten
length just outside off. Jaiswal gets onto the front foot and drives on the up towards cover point
length delivery hung up well outside off. Curves away and goes past Jaiswal's flailing blade
length in the channel just outside off. Buttler nibbles at it and guides it down to third man with an open bat face
length outside off. Buttler waits in his crease and punches it neatly past extra cover for a couple of runs
streaky! Back of a length outside off. Jaiswal has a swish at it and squirts it off the inside edge past the stumps, and the keeper. Gets a brace for his toil
off the mark in style! Marginally short outside off. Jaiswal picks the ball and stands up on his toes. Gets his hands through the ball and threads it between extra cover and cover point!
fuller outside off. Jaiswal drives but cannot get it past the fielder at short extra cover
hard length on middle and leg. Jaiswal gets behind the line and plays it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Shapes back into Jaiswal as he hops up onto his toes and defends
short and wide outside off. Jaiswal lets that one go. Not very far away from being called a wide either

Rashid wins it for the Gujarat Titans off the final ball! Oh my, this is some finish, and the Afghan Titan has come up trumps just when they needed him to! And the Royals, who looked so good for so much of the game, are no longer invincible! Short, wide and that is just begging to be hit. Not the best ball to bowl at this stage. Rashid lays back deep in his crease, brings those fast hands into play and thumps it over point. Speeds away to the fence and Rashid wheels away in celebration. He gestures to the dugout to not worry while he is there, and today, he has proven it!

Tewatia gets it over mid off, but it does not go for four! And there is a run out too! Short and wide outside off. Tewatia holds his nerve and slaps it over mid off. Buttler puts on his skates and pulls it back into play. The batters get across for two runs comfortably and then they decide to go for the third. Tewatia is always struggling to get there. The throw is accurate enough, and Avesh does the rest, with Tewatia well short. In the middle of all of that, there was a check for a short run. That has been sorted now, and GT need 2 off the last ball!
low full toss, following the batter on leg stump. Rashid can only dig it out towards extra cover for a single

an outside edge but they all count! Oh my days, the drama in Jaipur! Nails the wide yorker but Rashid somehow gets this away. He swishes hard at it and squirts it off the outside edge past the keeper!

almost a yorker, just outside off. Rashid sits deep in his crease and tugs it towards long on. They hare back for two and RR are lucky there was someone backing up at the keeper's end. That throw was wild
four off the first ball, oh my! Low full toss outside off. Rashid steps across his stumps and then shovels it over square leg. Deep mid wicket cannot get there either!
four to finish the over! Shortish outside off and this sits up nicely to be hit. Tewatia opens up his stance and boshes it over mid off!
follows the batter well outside leg. Bowls it on a length and Rashid cannot connect with his swipe. The ball pings off the pads into the on side. Rashid livid with himself
slower ball that goes wrong and slides well down leg. Another wide, and Sen might just be feeling the pressure now

taken at deep square leg but it will not count! Banged into the track just outside off. Gets up very high and Rashid cannot control his pull. Skies it and deep square leg takes it running in. A brace to Rashid

shot! Goes for the wide yorker but errs on the fuller side. Rashid, sitting deep in his crease, gets under it and scythes it over extra cover. And, it gets worse for the Royals because Sen has overstepped...
back of a length outside off. Tewatia sits deep in his crease and swings it away towards deep mid wicket
gets it over! Rank wide full toss and Tewatia makes the most of it. Does not middle it but gets enough to clear extra cover. Buttler gives chase from mid off but cannot rein it in!
full and angled across the batter well outside off. Beyond the tramlines too, and called a wide

sizzling yorker, honing into the pads. Rashid whips at it and squirts it away towards short fine leg. Might have nutmegged himself too but the important detail is that it is just a single. By the way, had Avesh hit the stumps at the batter's end, Tewatia was well out of his ground

what a save! Slower ball dug into the track outside off. Rashid stands up tall and slaps it flat towards long on. Buttler puts in a dive to his left and somehow manages to stop it on the half-volley. He went at it reverse-cupped and got the job done!
well beyond the tramlines again, and some more exercise for the umpire
short and too wide outside off. Rashid swishes and misses, and the umpire has no qualms in stretching out his arms
slower bumper on middle and off. Tewatia waits an eternity for it before dragging it towards deep square leg
short and wide outside off. Stops in the surface a little and Rashid cuts it towards deep cover point

Avesh traps Shahrukh in front! Low full toss slinging into off stump, Shahrukh walks across his stumps, swipes at it and misses. Gets pinged on the full, in front of middle and off, and the umpire raises his finger. Shahrukh has reviewed this because, well, why not. No bat involved, and three reds on Ball Tracking, with the ball pounding into middle stump!
hard length just outside off. Tewatia gives himself room and dabs it towards deep cover point
full and wide outside off. Shahrukh reaches out for it and clinks it towards deep cover point

Tewatia in on the act now! Ashwin bowls it very wide outside off after seeing Tewatia advance. The batter, though, is up to the challenge. Holds his shape, goes through the line and eases it over extra cover!
back of a length just outside off. Shahrukh has a wild slog at it and shanks it towards deep mid wicket
four more! Ashwin sprays this down leg, and this is very ordinary bowling. Shahrukh uses the pace and the angle, and just paddles it past short fine leg!
fetch that! Ashwin ventures into Shahrukh's slot, and he gets walloped. Shahrukh gets his front foot out of the way and biffs it over wide long on!
back of a length outside off. Tewatia is content to knock it to long off for a single
darted in on a length on middle and leg. Shahrukh punches it off the front foot towards long on

huge appeal, not given! Slider on a length on middle and leg. Skids on and Shahrukh has no clue about this. He is awfully late on the stroke and the ball seems to kiss the pad before skewing away off the inside edge. RR think there is enough in it to go upstairs, and review. The ball has hit the front pad, well before it makes contact with the bat. All eyes on Ball Tracking now. The impact is Umpire's Call and Ball Tracking reckons the ball would have missed leg stump comfortably. RR out of reviews now!
length just outside off. Tewatia tips it into the mid wicket region again but this time, he hits it too well. Cannot come back for the second
full on leg stump. Tewatia bunts it into the open spaces in the mid wicket region and races back for two
tossed up full just outside off. Shahrukh pushes it towards the bowler, who misfields and allows the batter to get off the mark

stumped by a mile! Chahal outwits Gill, and this is a humongous moment in the game! Tossed up deliciously outside off and Gill thinks he can dance down and go inside out again. He runs down the track but to his dismay, finds that the ball is wider and shorter than he anticipated. Cannot get close enough to it and swishes at fresh air. Samson collects and then whips off the bails. Chahal points to his head, and even though that was called a wide, RR will not mind. Looks like this dismissal was plotted by Chahal and Maharaj. Gill, meanwhile, is utterly disconsolate!
four more! Gill is coming after the Rajasthan Royals! This is shorter and there is plenty of width on offer too. Gill stays back and batters it past cover point!
surgical precision! Floated up full outside off. Gill skips down the track like a gazelle and then crunches it between long off and deep extra cover!
in the slot on off stump. Gill plants his front foot and powers it on the bounce to long off
full on leg stump. Gill presses forward and flicks it to long on. Has enough time to get back for two
picks the gap! Length outside off. Gill picks the length early, comes out of his bunker and crashes it past extra cover for four!
shortish on middle and off. Tewatia gets down low and swings it away towards deep square leg
full on leg stump. Gill gets to the pitch and drives it neatly to long on
darted down leg, and that is a freebie. Gill gets down on one knee and helps it past short fine leg. Vital boundary!

knocks Shankar over! Slider on a length on middle and off. Bowled at 93.3kph and Shankar does not really account for this change in pace. Tries to smash it into next week and loses track of it completely. Goes past the bat and Shankar hears the death rattle soon after. RR keep chipping away!
hung up full and wide outside off. Gill scuffs it towards deep extra cover
slightly quicker and flatter on a full length on leg stump. Shankar shanks it towards deep mid wicket
Shankar brings out the reverse! Floated up on a length outside off. Shankar gets into position in a flash and cracks it over backward point!
tossed up full and wide outside off. Gill drills it straight to deep extra cover
short and wide outside off. Gill slaps it to long off's left and asks Shankar to look for two immediately. Both batters have ample time to get it in the end
hard length again, denying Shankar any room on off stump. He tries to manufacture some but can only dab it towards backward point
hard length on off. Comes onto Gill a little quicker than anticipated and he hacks it to deep mid wicket
dug in short on off stump. Gill stands up tall and short-arm jabs it towards deep mid wicket. Another brace completed rather comfortably
length on middle and leg. Gill flicks it towards deep mid wicket and immediately calls for two. Gets back with ease
shortish outside off. Shankar gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep cover point
up and over! Sen goes full but over-pitches on middle and off. Shankar just focusses on meeting it with a straight bat and chips it over mid off!
wayward short delivery down leg. Some more exercise for the umpire

back of a length on leg stump. Gill nurdles it into the mid wicket region and this time, he has to scamper back. Puts on his skates, and makes it in the end. There was no one in the ring, meaning that Maharaj had to go after it
back of a length outside off. Gill cuts it towards deep cover and has enough time to canter back for the second
length on middle and off. Shankar comes half forward and nudges it into the mid on region
darted into the pads. Gill swipes it towards deep backward square leg. Just a single
shortish just outside off. Grips and spins away, albeit slowly. Shankar tries to work it to leg and ends up squirting it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
angled in on a back of a length on off. Gill punches it down the ground to long off
off the mark in pristine fashion! Sen strays onto the pads and pays the price. Shankar uses all the pace on offer and whips it through mid wicket!
full and honing into off stump. Shankar is caught on the crease and pokes it towards short extra cover

off stump is flat on the ground! Kuldeep Sen is on absolute fire! Heat-seeking 144.9kph delivery, bowled on a hard length on off. Nips away against the angle and that squares up Manohar completely. His feet, like Wade, go nowhere and he prods at it in hope. The ball whistles past the outside edge and leaves his off stump in a mess! It is raining wickets after the rain break, and GT in all sorts of trouble now!
full on middle and off. Gill gets a confident stride in and flicks it to long on
dug in short on leg stump. Manohar gets up on his toes and tucks it off his hips to get off the mark

wicket right after the rain break! 146.3kph length ball, angling across the batter outside off. Wade's feet are stuck to concrete and he has an airy waft at it. No shape on the stroke and he chunks it off the inside edge. Smashes into the stumps, and Sen has two in very quick succession!

big appeal, called a wide! Short and wide outside off. Wade goes fishing at it away from his body and seems to miss it. Kumar Dharmasena calls it a wide but Samson is adamant that has grazed the outside edge on the way. RR review. Clear daylight between bat and ball, and RR burn a review!
shot! Full on middle and leg. Gill plants his front foot, brings his wrists into play and whips this between deep mid wicket and long on!
slower on a length outside off. Gill waits in his crease and cuts it past backward point for a brace
back of a length just outside off. Looks like a slider and this skids on. Gill is cramped for room and jabs it towards backward point
back of a length on leg stump. Wade hangs back and taps it to long on
back of a length on middle and off. Gill stands tall and knocks it to long off
googly on a length just outside off. Wade lunges forward and pokes it towards point for a single
shortish outside off. Wade throws his hands at it and laces it towards deep cover point
fullish just outside off. Gill comes half forward and pushes it towards deep cover point
back of a length on leg stump. Wade hops around his crease before glancing it down to deep backward square leg
oh, hello! Sharp bumper on leg stump. Almost makes Wade sniff the leather and he does well to get out of the way

huge appeal, not given! Full and speared into middle and off. Sudharsan shapes for the lap but makes a complete hash of it. Seems to miss it completely and gets pinned on the pads, right in front of middle and off. Kumar Dharmasena has a long look at it, grimaces too but does not raise his finger. RR go upstairs. No bat involved. Ball Tracking coming up now and...it reckons the ball would have thundered into middle and off stump. Sen has a wicket in his first over!
full on the pads. Gill uses the pace and works it towards deep square leg. That was bowled at 144.3kph
bowled slow on a shortish length outside off. Sudharsan nurdles it into the vast open spaces in the mid wicket region and picks up two
fullish on leg stump. Gill comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket

dropped, this is becoming contagious! Back of a length on middle and off. Grips in the surface and spins back sharply. Holds in the surface too, and Sudharsan pops it back to Chahal, who puts it down. Not sure Chahal picked it right off the bat
slowed up nicely on a length on off. Sudharsan is beaten in the air and cannot get to the pitch despite advancing. Spins into him and hits him on the front pad
back to back boundaries for Sudharsan! Another long-hop, this time well outside off. Sudharsan cashes in on the width and belts it past extra cover!
